entries.gloss: the thing sold is distinguished from other property and determined (not an undetermined measure from a heap), so it enters the new owner's ḍamān without qabḍ

anchor.excerpt_ar: إذا تميز المعقود عليه من غيره وتعين

entries.gloss: the thing disposed of is undetermined (mubham), the one case where disposal before qabḍ is barred

anchor.excerpt_ar: ولا منع من التصرف إلا في المبهم خاصة

entries.gloss: the disposer's right in the thing is settled, not something absent that may never reach him (the stipend, the alms)

anchor.excerpt_ar: لأن حقهم مستقر فيه

entries.gloss: the disposal is a sale of a debt to someone other than the debtor

anchor.excerpt_ar: بيع الدين من غير الغريم

entries.gloss: the right-holder has demanded his right or taken it, settling it in the thing

anchor.excerpt_ar: بمطالبة من له الحق بحقه أو يأخذه بحقه

entries.gloss: the right demanded is in the thing itself and cannot be turned aside from it

anchor.excerpt_ar: طالب بحقه الذي لا يمكن دفعه عنه

entries.gloss: the disposal extinguishes another's right in the thing

anchor.excerpt_ar: التصرف المسقط لحق غيره

entries.gloss: the cause of the would-be owner's ownership is complete, past the other party's power to defeat it

anchor.excerpt_ar: لأن سبب الملك قد استقر له

entries.gloss: the disposer's own tie to the thing never wholly lapsed (as the marriage of the revocably divorced wife)

anchor.excerpt_ar: الرجعية لم يزل النكاح عنها بالكلية

entries.gloss: the contract's condition precedes the contract

anchor.excerpt_ar: لا بد من سبقها

entries.gloss: the contract's condition exists concurrently with the contract, not before it

anchor.excerpt_ar: إذا وجدت مقترنة بها ولم يتقدم عليها

entries.gloss: the ruling coincides in time with what bars it

anchor.excerpt_ar: إذا تقارن الحكم ووجود المنع منه

entries.gloss: he began the act knowing that its prohibition was due at a time about to come

anchor.excerpt_ar: لإقدامه على الفعل مع علمه بتحريمه في وقته لا سيما مع قرب الوقت

entries.gloss: the act is an annulment (faskh), not a contract

anchor.excerpt_ar: وأما الفسوخ فترد على المعدوم حكما واختيارا

entries.gloss: the annulment is the return for a defect of a thing that has wholly perished

anchor.excerpt_ar: إذا تلفت العين المعيبة كلها

entries.gloss: the rescission of the non-binding contract harms a party or another connected with the contract

anchor.excerpt_ar: متى تضمن ضررا على أحد المتعاقدين أو غيرهما ممن له تعلق بالعقد

entries.gloss: the harm can be made good by liability or the like

anchor.excerpt_ar: إلا أن يمكن استدراك الضرر بضمان أو نحوه

entries.gloss: the deputy's mandate is general, a deputy for the Muslims rather than for his principal

anchor.excerpt_ar: كان نائبا عن المسلمين كالأمير العام

entries.gloss: the deputy is the qāḍī's deputy

anchor.excerpt_ar: وأما نواب القاضي فنوعان

entries.gloss: the office removed is a public office carrying a right of God (as the judge's)

anchor.excerpt_ar: لأن في ولايته حقا لله

entries.gloss: the actor knew of the permission (the condition) when he acted; the qāʿida's case is acting before knowing

anchor.excerpt_ar: فتصرف قبل العلم به

entries.gloss: all that turns on the condition is liability, which mere belief does not establish

anchor.excerpt_ar: لأن الضمان لا يثبت بمجرد الاعتقاد فيما ليس بمضمون

entries.gloss: the unknown condition is the actor's own authority over the property, as the owner's permission to transact in it

anchor.excerpt_ar: لو تصرف في مال غيره بعقد أو غيره ثم تبين أنه كان أذن له في التصرف

entries.gloss: the right of qiṣāṣ belongs to the victim himself, not to his heirs

anchor.excerpt_ar: أن القصاص هل يجب للميت أو لورثته

entries.gloss: he acted relying on a basis he believed

anchor.excerpt_ar: تصرف مستندا إلى سبب

entries.gloss: a valid basis other than the one he relied on in fact existed

anchor.excerpt_ar: وأن السبب المعتمد غيره وهو موجود

entries.gloss: the right came back to him by gift (not by release)

anchor.excerpt_ar: فيرجع بالهبة دون الإبراء

entries.gloss: the contract on the work is binding, the work owed in the dhimma for a countervalue (as hire)

anchor.excerpt_ar: إما أن يكون لازما ثابتا في الذمة بعوض كالإجارة

entries.gloss: a condition or indication requires him to do the work himself

anchor.excerpt_ar: ولا يتعين أن يعمله المعقود معه إلا بشرط أو قرينة تدل عليه

entries.gloss: an express permission or an indication of it allows him to put another in his place

anchor.excerpt_ar: إلا بإذن صريح أو قرينة دالة عليه

entries.gloss: the agent is expressly declared to fall under the general object

anchor.excerpt_ar: إلا مع التصريح بالدخول

entries.gloss: indications (qarāʾin) show the agent is meant by the general object

anchor.excerpt_ar: أو قرائن تدل عليه

entries.gloss: he eats under necessity

anchor.excerpt_ar: فيجوز الأكل منه للضرورة بلا نزاع

entries.gloss: he holds wilāya over the property for the ward's benefit (not for his own protection)

anchor.excerpt_ar: وإن كانت الولاية لمصلحة المولى عليه

entries.gloss: he is otherwise paid for his work (the agent's and hireling's wage), so needs no eating in return for it

anchor.excerpt_ar: لاستغنائهما عنه بطلب الأجرة من المؤجر والموكل

entries.gloss: the food is what souls crave and is not guarded or protected

anchor.excerpt_ar: فيما تتوق إليه النفوس مع عدم الحفظ والاحتراز عليه

entries.gloss: the stipulated maintenance and clothing are a countervalue (muʿāwaḍa)

anchor.excerpt_ar: فأما المعاوضة

entries.gloss: the contract in which it is stipulated is binding

anchor.excerpt_ar: فتقع في العقود اللازمة

entries.gloss: what was given has been spent and used in its purpose (the mount in the path of God, the clothing)

anchor.excerpt_ar: الدابة قد صرفت في سبيل الله واستعملت فيه

entries.gloss: the stipulated benefit is a hire of the party, set against a countervalue

anchor.excerpt_ar: أن يكون استئجارا له مقابلا بعوض

entries.gloss: the worker's state indicates that he claims a countervalue for the work

anchor.excerpt_ar: أن يعمل العمل ودلالة حاله تقتضي المطالبة بالعوض

entries.gloss: the work serves the Muslims' general interests or rescues protected property from loss

anchor.excerpt_ar: أن يعمل عملا فيه غناء عن المسلمين وقيام بمصالحهم العامة أو فيه استنقاذ لمال معصوم من الهلكة

entries.gloss: the subordinate property was added by transgression (the usurper's planting and building)

anchor.excerpt_ar: غراس الغاصب وبناؤه

entries.gloss: the subordinate property can be separated without harm reaching the owner of the principal

anchor.excerpt_ar: وإن كان يمكن فصله بدون ضرر يلحق مالك الأصل

entries.gloss: freeing his own property brings a loss on another's property

anchor.excerpt_ar: من أدخل النقص على ملك غيره لاستصلاح تملكه

entries.gloss: the one who suffered the loss was negligent

anchor.excerpt_ar: وإن كان منه تفريط

entries.gloss: the sufferer permitted the freeing of his property where the other could not be compelled to it

anchor.excerpt_ar: إذن في تفريغ ملكه من ملك غيره حيث لا يجبر الآخر على التفريغ

entries.gloss: the crop was sown with a valid permission; the qāʿida's case is crop without one

anchor.excerpt_ar: الزرع النابت في أرض الغير بغير إذن صحيح

entries.gloss: the roots bear repeatedly (herbs and vegetables)

anchor.excerpt_ar: ما تكرر حمله من أصول البقول والخضراوات

entries.gloss: the property reverts by annulment to the one from whom ownership moved

anchor.excerpt_ar: العائدة إلى من انتقل الملك عنه بالمفسوخ

entries.gloss: the growth's question concerns security (tawthiqa) or liability (ḍamān)

anchor.excerpt_ar: ويتبع الأصل في التوثقة والضمان

entries.gloss: a crop or fruit bought on condition of cutting was left until it ripened or hardened

anchor.excerpt_ar: اشترى قصيلا بشرط القطع فتركه حتى سنبل واشتد

entries.gloss: the contract is binding: the party or his substitute cannot undo it alone without a cause

anchor.excerpt_ar: فما كان منه لازما لا يستقل العاقد أو من يقوم مقامه بإبطاله من غير سبب

entries.gloss: the contract bears on the thing itself

anchor.excerpt_ar: كان العقد واردا على العين

entries.gloss: the growth shares the meaning that made its principal guaranteed or held in trust

anchor.excerpt_ar: إن شارك الأصل في المعنى الذي أوجب الضمان أو الائتمان

entries.gloss: the annulment lifts the contract from its origin, not from now

anchor.excerpt_ar: الفسخ هل هو رفع للعقد من أصله

entries.gloss: the right tied to the thing is binding, undoable in no way (as the umm walad's right)

anchor.excerpt_ar: حقا لازما لا يمكن إبطاله بوجه كحق الاستيلاد

entries.gloss: the ruling bears on another by cause of the ḥaml, not on the ḥaml in itself

anchor.excerpt_ar: ما يتعلق بسبب الحمل بغيره

entries.gloss: the sign of pregnancy has appeared, so the ḥaml's existence is the apparent

anchor.excerpt_ar: فإذا ظهرت أمارة الحمل كان وجوده هو الظاهر
